name: AhaNow
summary: Browser-based AI studio that turns a topic, script or source files into a narrated, presenter-free explainer video. You review the script and scene plan before it renders an MP4 for use in a course.

value: Short explainer lessons on a complex topic
Turning notes or a script into narrated video
Starts from a topic, script, notes or uploaded files (PDFs, images, audio, video)
Editable script and scene plan before generation, with a choice of visual style
Scene-by-scene revision; changing the spoken words regenerates the voice
Exports an MP4, or a ZIP with an FCPXML timeline and media for further editing
Captions and transcript shown on the vendor's published example

value.from: US$12 a month (Lite), up to US$799 a month (Studio)
value.notes: Six plans on one shared credit balance for video, speech, music and dubbing. Monthly credits expire two months after issue. No free tier listed; the FAQ says trial allowances vary by account. Payments are non-refundable except where the law requires. The pricing page showed a limited-time discount on 21 Nov 2026.

Primary storage in Hong Kong, with some processing in the US and elsewhere. The privacy policy sets out GDPR legal bases and uses SCCs and the UK addendum for transfers. Private content is removed from active systems about 30 days after deletion and from backups about 90 days later. Users must be 18 or over.

By default the vendor uses user content, generated content and voice data to train and fine-tune its models. Users can opt out in Settings, but only for future content. Voice data in the EEA, UK and Switzerland needs opt-in, and business content excluded by contract isn't used. Third-party model providers are contractually barred from training on it. Per the pricing page, high-quality mode uses Opus 5.5, standard mode DeepSeek V4.1, and video clips Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3.

researchTasks: Added from a /submit entry (20 Nov 2026). Reviewer access is demo only, so the product is profiled, not evaluated.

Vendor follow-up sent: LMS/SCORM export plans, caption and transcript export for user videos, languages, security certifications and sub-processor list, DPA for business customers (contractual training exclusion), data residency options outside Hong Kong, accessibility (VPAT/WCAG), trial terms, company details.

dataGaps.note: No SCORM, xAPI or LTI on the vendor's pages; video files only.
No LMS or other integrations stated.
Captions and transcript appear on the vendor's example; whether user videos export captions or transcripts, and any WCAG claim, not stated.
Encryption in transit and at rest 'where supported'; no certifications or sub-processor list stated.
